nome_articolo: First4Figures Cowboy Bebop Spike Spiegel 1/8 Resin (Statua)
descrizione:
First 4 Figures is proud to present its latest 1/8th scale collectible resin statue, Spike Spiegel.
Spike Spiegel is a bounty hunter known for his casual charm, sarcastic wit, and unparalleled mastery of martial arts and weapons. Beneath his seemingly indifferent demeanor lies a complex past, giving him a cold yet tragic presence.
This high-quality 1/8th scale resin statue depicts Spike Spiegel in a relaxed pose, a cigarette in his right hand and his suit jacket draped casually over his left shoulder. The statue faithfully captures Spike's distinctive appearance, including his tousled hair, blue suit with a yellow shirt, and his tall, slender figure. The base features a meticulously crafted abstract design, perfectly echoing the iconic art style of the Cowboy Bebop opening credits.
